name: ClippingHighlightRenderer
src_typeComment: The drawing half of the Level Transform Guidance — draws a flagged object a second time with the ZTest Greater highlight material, so only its buried portion shows.  Deliberately does NOT swap materials on the objects themselves: a material swap that errors mid-scan leaves debug materials baked into a real scene, and undoing that by hand is miserable. Drawing an extra pass via Graphics.DrawMeshNow touches nothing the scene actually owns, so toggling the tool off is always clean.

src_members.sig: public static void DrawMeshHighlight(GameObject subject, Material material, int materialPass)
src_members.name: DrawMeshHighlight
src_members.comment: Mesh mode: the visual model, for judging visual-quality clipping (seams, sunk props). materialPass selects the shader's highlight style — 0 = buried portion only, 1 = whole object.

src_members.sig: public static void DrawColliderHighlight(GameObject subject, Material material, int materialPass)
src_members.name: DrawColliderHighlight
src_members.comment: Collider mode: the actual collision shapes, for judging traversal/metric problems — these often differ from the visual mesh, which is exactly the class of bug you'd otherwise never see.
